advNeedsTime: This needs an exact birth time and place.
advShadbalaIntro: Shadbala measures how able each planet is to deliver its results (BPHS ch. 27). The marker shows the classical minimum; a bar beyond it means the planet is considered strong.
advShadbalaParts: Sthana {sthana} · Dig {dig} · Kala {kala} · Chesta {chesta} · Naisargika {nai} · Drik {drik}
advShadbalaNote: Calculated in virupas (60 = 1 rupa). Software differs in a few sub-parts (Chesta, Abda/Masa lords, Yuddha); our method choices are listed in the open-source code, so numbers may differ slightly from other programs.
advAshtakavargaIntro: Benefic points (bindus) each sign receives from the seven planets and the Lagna. Signs with 28 or more points in the Sarvashtakavarga are traditionally considered supportive for transits.
advJaiminiIntro: Jaimini astrology uses movable significators (chara karakas), arudha padas and sign-based dashas.
advCharaDashaNote: Method of K.N. Rao: the direction follows the 9th sign from the Lagna; years are counted from each sign to its lord. Other Chara dasha variants exist.
advLalKitabIntro: In Lal Kitab the signs are fixed to the houses (Aries = 1st house) and each planet sits in the house of its sign. Meanings below are short summaries of the Lal Kitab tradition.
advSleepingNote: Simplified rule: an empty house that is not aspected from the opposite house. Lal Kitab commentators use further aspect rules.
advVarshphalNote: Lal Kitab Varshphal (annual chart) is not included yet: we only publish tables we have verified against a primary source.
advProgressionsNote: A day after birth stands for a year of life. The MC is moved by the solar arc and the Ascendant derived from it.
advSolarReturnNote: The chart for the moment the Sun returns to its birth position each year, cast for the birthplace.
advCompositeIntro: A composite chart places every planet at the midpoint between two people's positions. Western astrologers read it as the chart of the relationship itself.
advCompositeNeedProfiles: Add at least two profiles with birth dates to make a composite chart.
